device.title: Choose a thermostat
device.description: The account has several thermostats. Choose the one to add; add the integration again for each of the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Salus iT500 re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Salus rejected the saved password of account {username}. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Salus API
error.no_devices: No devices found for this account

abort.already_configured: Every thermostat of this account is already configured

invalid_auth.message: Salus rejected the credentials, re-authenticate the integration

schedule_zone_unsupported.message: The weekly program of this zone cannot be reached; only the first heating zone is supported.

schedule_unavailable.message: The Salus web portal is not set up, so the weekly program cannot be read.

get_schedule.name: Read weekly program
get_schedule.description: Returns the weekly heating program the thermostat is running.

set_schedule.name: Write weekly program
set_schedule.description: Writes one daily program to every day of the week and confirms the thermostat took it.

slots.name: Steps
slots.description: One to six steps, each a time and a temperature. An iT500 reached through the web portal needs all six: it keeps steps that are not overwritten.
